# `armadad kv`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

kv runs this server's member of armada-kv, Armada's own store of the control
plane's state (ADR 0057), on a cluster made with `armadad init --state kv`. systemd
starts it as armada-kv.service on such a cluster's servers. It works the member
out as the server does (name, data in kv/, addresses, certificate), listens on the
server's private IP only (7445 for the store's API, 7446 for the other members),
TLS 1.3 with the cluster's member certificates on both, and stops in order on
SIGTERM. It refuses while another process holds the member. On a server whose
state is in etcd it exits at once (status 78) and armada-kv.service stays stopped.
Flags it does not know (the server's, from ARMADA_SERVER_FLAGS) are ignored.

```
armadad kv [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
sudo systemctl enable --now armada-kv armada-server   # a server of a cluster on armada-kv
sudo systemctl status armada-kv
sudo armadad kv --data-dir /var/lib/armada            # in the foreground
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
